sentences.sk: Marek cestuje vlakom do Bratislavy.
sentences.en: Marek travels to Bratislava by train.

sentences.sk: Vyrastal v zahraničí a po slovensky hovorí pomaly.
sentences.en: He grew up abroad and speaks Slovak slowly.

sentences.sk: Jeho otec bol občanom Slovenskej republiky, keď sa Marek narodil.
sentences.en: His father was a citizen of the Slovak Republic when Marek was born.

sentences.sk: Marek chce zistiť, ako môže svoje občianstvo úradne preukázať.
sentences.en: Marek wants to find out how he can officially prove his citizenship.

sentences.sk: Pred klientskym centrom naňho čaká kamarátka Dominika.
sentences.en: His friend Dominika waits for him outside the client centre.

sentences.sk: Dominika pozná mesto a ide s ním dovnútra.
sentences.en: Dominika knows the city and goes inside with him.

sentences.sk: Marek má v taške pas, svoj rodný list a otcov rodný list.
sentences.en: Marek has his passport, his birth certificate, and his father's birth certificate in his bag.

sentences.sk: Doklady má v priečinku, aby ich rýchlo našiel.
sentences.en: He keeps the documents in a folder so he can find them quickly.

sentences.sk: Pri informačnom pulte sa opýta: „Kde môžem podať žiadosť o vydanie osvedčenia o štátnom občianstve?“
sentences.en: At the information desk he asks, “Where can I submit an application for a certificate of citizenship?”

sentences.sk: Pracovník mu ukáže správne oddelenie.
sentences.en: A staff member shows him the right department.

sentences.sk: Marek si vezme poradové číslo a sadne si vedľa Dominiky.
sentences.en: Marek takes a queue number and sits down next to Dominika.

sentences.sk: „Čo ak nerozumiem každej otázke?“ spýta sa.
sentences.en: “What if I don't understand every question?” he asks.

sentences.sk: „Môžeš poprosiť o pomalšie vysvetlenie,“ povie Dominika.
sentences.en: “You can ask for a slower explanation,” Dominika says.

sentences.sk: Po chvíli sa na obrazovke objaví jeho číslo.
sentences.en: After a while his number appears on the screen.

sentences.sk: Pri okienku pozdraví úradníčku.
sentences.en: At the counter he greets the clerk.

sentences.sk: „Chcel by som požiadať o osvedčenie o štátnom občianstve Slovenskej republiky,“ povie.
sentences.en: “I would like to apply for a certificate of citizenship of the Slovak Republic,” he says.

sentences.sk: „Môj otec bol občanom Slovenskej republiky, keď som sa narodil.“
sentences.en: “My father was a citizen of the Slovak Republic when I was born.”

sentences.sk: Úradníčka si pozrie jeho doklad totožnosti a rodný list.
sentences.en: The clerk looks at his identity document and birth certificate.

sentences.sk: Potom sa spýta na otcove doklady.
sentences.en: Then she asks about his father's documents.

sentences.sk: Marek jej podá otcov rodný list a vysvetlí, čo o otcovi vie.
sentences.en: Marek hands her his father's birth certificate and explains what he knows about his father.

sentences.sk: Úradníčka povie, že úrad musí údaje overiť.
sentences.en: The clerk says the office must verify the information.

sentences.sk: „Možno budeme potrebovať aj ďalšie doklady,“ dodá.
sentences.en: “We may also need more documents,” she adds.

sentences.sk: Marek sa spýta: „Čo ešte potrebujem priniesť?“
sentences.en: Marek asks, “What else do I need to bring?”

sentences.sk: Úradníčka hovorí rýchlo, preto ju Marek poprosí: „Môžete to, prosím, zopakovať pomalšie?“
sentences.en: The clerk speaks quickly, so Marek asks her, “Could you please repeat that more slowly?”

sentences.sk: Dominika si zapíše názvy dokladov do telefónu.
sentences.en: Dominika writes the names of the documents in her phone.

sentences.sk: Marek vyplní žiadosť a skontroluje svoje meno aj dátum narodenia.
sentences.en: Marek fills in the application and checks his name and date of birth.

sentences.sk: Pýta sa, kedy môže očakávať odpoveď.
sentences.en: He asks when he can expect a reply.

sentences.sk: Úradníčka vysvetlí, že osvedčenie sa zvyčajne nevydáva hneď.
sentences.en: The clerk explains that the certificate is not usually issued immediately.

sentences.sk: Marek odchádza bez osvedčenia, ale vie, čo má robiť ďalej.
sentences.en: Marek leaves without the certificate, but he knows what to do next.

sentences.sk: Dominika navrhne kávu a on sa po náročnom ráne konečne usmeje.
sentences.en: Dominika suggests coffee, and after a demanding morning he finally smiles.

glossary.note: Literally 'in a foreign country'; common when describing where someone lived.
Instrumental singular after pred (in front of).
A document recording a person's birth and parentage. This is a document to bring, if the office requires it.

glossary.meaning: birth-related; in rodný list, birth certificate
glossary.note: Used together with list in the official term rodný list.

glossary.meaning: document; in rodný list, birth certificate
glossary.note: The whole phrase rodný list means birth certificate; list on its own can also mean a sheet or letter.
Feminine noun. Here it means the written application submitted to the office.
The office issues this certificate to prove citizenship; the applicant requests it rather than bringing it to the appointment.
Genitive form after vydanie (issuance of); the dictionary form begins osvedčenie.
Neuter noun. In this story it is the document issued to prove citizenship.
Dictionary form; Marek wants to prove svoje občianstvo (his citizenship).
Locative singular after o (about/of) in osvedčenie o štátnom občianstve.
The number showing when it is your turn at the counter.
For example, a passport or identity card.
The office may ask for more documents depending on the person's situation.
Useful in the request Môžete to, prosím, zopakovať pomalšie?
Third person singular; here he fills in the application.

questions.promptSk: Prečo ide Marek do klientskeho centra?

options.text: Chce zistiť, ako preukázať svoje občianstvo.

questions.explanationEn: Marek wants to learn how to officially prove his citizenship.

questions.promptSk: Kto ide s Marekom do centra?
questions.explanationEn: His friend Dominika meets him and goes inside with him.

questions.promptSk: Čo Marek povie úradníčke o svojom otcovi?

options.text: Otec bol občanom Slovenskej republiky, keď sa Marek narodil.

questions.explanationEn: Marek says his father was a Slovak citizen when Marek was born.

questions.promptSk: Čo Marek požiada úradníčku, keď hovorí rýchlo?
questions.explanationEn: He asks the clerk to repeat the information more slowly.

options.text: Nie, ešte musí čakať na výsledok.

questions.explanationEn: The certificate is not normally issued immediately, so Marek leaves without it.
